title: Jordan induction for $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O})$
summary: Let $\mathcal{O}$ be a complete discrete valuation ring with a finite residue field. We introduce a simple framework of constructing smooth representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal{O})$ modulo the knowledge of nilpotent orbits, called Jordan induction, which enjoys several remarkable properties: It yields only irreducible representations, it yields all the even level irreducible representations, and up to conjugation it yields non-isomorphic representations.
